column1: # tools/mutations/m1-expected.tsv (1.4 M1; docs/M7D_CONTRACT.md §6 "変異の置き場所", §3.10, §4.2): the UI mutations of the
# branch r14-duo-m1, which is never merged. A push of it runs duo.yml's duo-shots once (path 3: the iPhone Duo's outer screen
# only; build.yml ignores r14-duo*). Each mutation is one line of the app marked "MUTATION <id>" and is told by the name of
# the one DuoLayoutUITests test it fails; no two share a set, none stops the build, crashes the app or fails a step before
# the UI tests. Base: 65734cc (r14-w-d1d), whose own duo-shots must pass first (its testFingerDefaultFollowsTheHinge expects
# off on the outer screen since 1.4 D1c).
# The run expected: the build, the photo checks' self-test, the photos and "The simulators used are the table's" pass;
# "DuoLayoutUITests on the iPhone Duo" fails with 4 ran, 3 failed (U1, U2, U3 below), testOuterHeaderRows passed and
# testInnerHeaderIsOneRow skipped; "The photos and the lines (shot_checks.py)" fails with exactly 1 error, U1's
# (outer-portrait-week-first.png finger=true, expected false). Any other failure, or a test named here passing, is a finding.
# Rows with the id "-" are not mutated on this branch (why in the row). Columns: id, the line mutated, what it does, the
# contract row it proves, the tests expected to FAIL, the nearest tests that must still PASS.

column3: PencilPhone.attach answers "no hinge" at once (hingeAnswered(false)) instead of attaching UIHingeInteraction (watchHinge): H never reaches FingerDefault, so a first launch on the outer screen keeps 「指でも書く」 on. PencilPhone.usesHinge stays true, the value DuoLayoutUITests.swift:52, duo.yml's DUO_USES_HINGE and shot_checks' section 4.2 rule agree on. The app takes the path it took with usesHinge false at f9bb459 (duo.yml run 44696154794: 15 photos and 4 UI tests passed), so no crash. After the UI tests, shot_checks.py fails with exactly 1 error (outer-portrait-week-first.png finger=true, expected false; shot_checks.py:464-468; the rule check is :475-481); its section 4.2 rule check still passes, since hinge= comes from ScreenshotMeasure's own interaction (ScreenshotMode.swift:1150-1151) and --uses-hinge from duo.yml:468. Checked on that run's photos and lines: 15 photos, 1 error.
